repositories.title: Animal Crossing
repositories.summary: Native Windows port on the ac-decomp decompilation, GX translated to OpenGL 3.3. Playtest builds (v0.9.3); needs your own US disc. AI-assisted port code (disclosed).

repositories.title: Drakengard 3
repositories.summary: BLUS31197 recompiled on ps3recomp with D3D12/Metal/Vulkan rendering. README reports chapter 1 playable at 60 fps; tested on few machines so far. Bring your own copy.

repositories.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories
repositories.summary: Byte-matching decompilation of the USA game ported to PC: up to 4x resolution, widescreen, 3D monsters, mods and a card editor. Needs your own USA disc image.

repositories.title: Gran Turismo 4, God of War II (PS2)
repositories.summary: Toolchain: turns your own disc into a page you run in your own browser (WebGPU). Two games brought up so far. Nothing playable online.

repositories.title: Half-Life 2 (Xbox)
repositories.summary: The 2005 Xbox version recompiled with xboxrecomp. Boots to its own main menu background with real textures, but the README says it is not playable yet.

repositories.title: Super Mario Odyssey
repositories.summary: Built on the ssbu-recomp runtime with a Vulkan renderer. README says early: played up to Cascade Kingdom. No releases; build from source with your own 1.0.0 dump.

repositories.title: Grand Theft Auto IV (Xbox 360 version)
repositories.summary: README says early development and not meant for public use. GTA IV also has an official 2008 PC version.

repositories.title: Ninja Gaiden II
repositories.summary: ReXGlue port of the 2008 original by TheSaltTrader, released Sept 2026. The original repository now returns 404; copies by others keep the source but have no release buil

repositories.title: Driveclub
repositories.summary: Despite the name, native execution with reimplemented PS4 libraries and Vulkan, not a static recompilation. Races playable per README; no online.

repositories.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
repositories.summary: AArch64-to-C recomp with a Vulkan renderer; version 13.0.4/13.0.5, your own dump and keys. 1v1 matches work; AI-built per README.

repositories.title: Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3
repositories.summary: Menus and fights playable per README; no releases yet, so it must be built from source with your own copy. Linux first, macOS experimental.

repositories.title: Bayonetta 2
repositories.summary: Translates the game on your PC from your own v1.2 ExeFS/RomFS dump; the release is only a builder. Prologue and early chapter 1 played; later chapters untested. Linux bui

repositories.title: flOw
repositories.summary: thatgamecompany's PSN debut, every function lifted to C on ps3recomp. Engine loop and D3D12 level rendering work; not yet a normal playable build. Linux planned.

repositories.title: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 3 Full Burst
repositories.summary: Closed-source XenonRecomp-based port aimed at Android phones (Vulkan, touch controls), plus a Windows build. Fights at 30 FPS per README. Needs your own NTSC-U copy.

repositories.title: Ace Combat 6: Fires of Liberation
repositories.summary: Earlier, separate ReXGlue attempt. Gets in-game with likely bugs per README; source only, no releases, no commits since March 2026.

repositories.title: Gran Turismo Sport
repositories.summary: Menus and races work offline; no online play. Fork of Ryty with a shadPS4-derived renderer.

repositories.title: Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock
repositories.summary: Furthest-along PS3 recomp: the game's own bot cleared all 45 Quickplay songs. 30-40 fps in songs, no guitar controller support yet. Source only, you build it yourself.

repositories.title: SSX Tricky
repositories.summary: USA Xbox release recompiled with xboxrecomp to D3D11. Frontend, races at 60 fps and saves work; marked work in progress. Repo holds no game code. Bring your own disc.

repositories.title: WWE 2K14
repositories.summary: ReXGlue port of the Xbox 360 version with a launcher. v1.0.0 out, a few days old, with known lighting and frame-rate issues. Needs your own game plus title update 1.0.3.

repositories.title: Driveclub
repositories.summary: PS4 code runs natively; Sony libraries reimplemented, graphics via shadPS4's Vulkan renderer (Windows) or a custom Metal renderer (Intel Mac). Needs your own dump.

repositories.title: PlayStation games (tool)
repositories.summary: Recompiler and runtime that turn PS1 executables into C#; needs no BIOS. A developer tool, not a playable port. Powers the MediEvil and Symphony of the Night recomp betas

repositories.title: Street Fighter Alpha 2, Vampire Savior and other CPS-2 games (Arcade)
repositories.summary: One launcher for ten Capcom CPS-2/CPS-1 games, each with training modes and widescreen. Fighters play start to finish; needs your own ROM set of the exact listed version.

repositories.title: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm Generations
repositories.summary: Closed-source XenonRecomp port aimed at phones (Mali/Adreno, Vulkan), fights at 30 fps; also a Windows build. Needs your own US disc files with the exact default.xex.

repositories.title: PlayStation 2 games (tool)
repositories.summary: Experimental recompiler and runtime that turns PS2 ELF code into C++; a developer tool, not a playable port. Per-game projects build on it.

repositories.title: FIFA Street 2
repositories.summary: Attempt at recompiling the original Xbox FIFA Street 2 with xboxrecomp. Reaches the recompiled entry point but opens no window yet. Not the 2012 FIFA Street PC port.

repositories.title: Original Xbox games (tool)
repositories.summary: SDK that recompiles original Xbox XBE code to C++ with D3D8 on D3D12; a developer tool, not a playable port. Used for the BLACK and Splinter Cell: Double Agent ports.

repositories.title: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate
repositories.summary: ARM64-to-C recompiler plus D3D11 runtime, built on your PC from your own copy, keys and firmware. Menus and matches run; Local Wireless online experimental.

repositories.title: Pepsiman
repositories.summary: psxrecomp-based browser build by Kem0x, first at pepsiman.ol.mr, later on his VL.MR site. On 2026-10-21 the site, repo and VL.MR page were all gone; no takedown notice fo

repositories.title: inFAMOUS Second Son
repositories.summary: A shadPS4 fork with patches for this game (EU release). One release (v1.0), not updated since.
